#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import csv

with open("data/attractions.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))
top = max(rows, key=lambda r: int(r["visits_2025"]))
name = top["attraction"].split(" (")[0]
visits = f"{int(top['visits_2025']):,}"

print(f"""```{{=typst}}
#set page(width: 12cm, height: 12cm, margin: 0.7cm, numbering: none, fill: rgb("#12284c"))
#set text(fill: white)
#set par(spacing: 0pt, leading: 0.3em)
#align(center + horizon, stack(
  dir: ttb,
  spacing: 0.35cm,
  text(size: 32pt, weight: "bold")[Visit London],
  image("images/natural-history-museum.jpg", width: 5.6cm, alt: "The empty Central Hall of the Natural History Museum, looking towards the blue whale skeleton"),
  text(size: 6pt, fill: luma(200))[Natural History Museum, Central Hall. Photo: Julian Herzog, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons.],
  text(size: 11pt)[London's most visited attraction],
  text(size: 15pt, weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#ffd23f"))[{name}],
  text(size: 13pt)[{visits} visits in 2025],
  text(size: 6pt, fill: luma(200))[Source: ALVA, Visits made in 2025 to visitor attractions in membership with ALVA.],
))
